items.title: Binance wins $6.5 billion feezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
items.summary: The crypto exchange said it has already replaced the stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves.

items.title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
items.summary: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
items.summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it.
